name: pyosmium
what_it_holds: Official Python bindings (BSD-2-Clause, 393 stars, 782 commits) for the libosmium C++ library, for fast low-level processing of OSM PBF files (including Geofabrik extracts and full history files with `.osh.pbf`).
why_useful: Lower-level building block than pyrosm; notably supports OSM's full-history PBF format, which is the closest thing to a point-in-time OSM POI census (can reconstruct what tourism=hotel tags existed as of a past date) — directly relevant to the point-in-time rule in this project.
time_coverage: Current + full OSM edit history when using history-enabled extracts
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Lower-level building block than pyrosm; notably supports OSM's full-history PBF format, which is the closest thing to a point-in-time OSM POI census (can reconstruct what tourism=hotel tags existed as of a past date) — directly relevant to the point-in-time rule in this project.

name: Nowcasting_toolbox
what_it_holds: Code and templates accompanying Linzenich & Meunier (2024), 'Nowcasting Made Easier: a Toolbox for Real-Time Predictions,' ECB Working Paper No. 3004 — a general-purpose real-time nowcasting toolbox (bridge-equation and DFM style) built by ECB staff, designed to be adapted to any target series with mixed-frequency indicators.
why_useful: Directly on-theme for gap #17 (bridge equations, DFM); an ECB-authored, paper-backed toolbox is a credible, documented starting point for building the ABNB revenue/nights bridge-equation nowcast the team already uses conceptually (H1-to-H2 bridge, Q4 guide arithmetic).
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
why_all: Directly on-theme for gap #17 (bridge equations, DFM); an ECB-authored, paper-backed toolbox is a credible, documented starting point for building the ABNB revenue/nights bridge-equation nowcast the team already uses conceptually (H1-to-H2 bridge, Q4 guide arithmetic).

name: nowcasting (R package)
what_it_holds: R package implementing Dynamic Factor Models with mixed frequencies and unbalanced panels (ragged-edge data), originally built for Brazilian central-bank-style nowcasting of GDP/activity indices.
why_useful: Reusable DFM engine for mixed-frequency/unbalanced-panel problems (gap #17); the ragged-edge handling is exactly the shape of the ABNB problem (macro releases and alt-data land at different times ahead of the print).
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
why_all: Reusable DFM engine for mixed-frequency/unbalanced-panel problems (gap #17); the ragged-edge handling is exactly the shape of the ABNB problem (macro releases and alt-data land at different times ahead of the print).

name: midasmlpy
what_it_holds: Python port of the midasml approach: regularized MIDAS regression using orthogonal-polynomial (Legendre) weighting plus sparse-group LASSO, fast proximal block-coordinate-descent solver, tools for high-dimensional mixed-frequency panel data. Sibling implementations exist in R, Julia, MATLAB. 151 commits, GPL-2.0, last updated 2025-05-15 (33 stars).
why_useful: High-dimensional MIDAS with regularization is well suited to nowcasting a quarterly ABNB KPI from many weekly/daily alt-data series (Trends, calendar pace, reviews index, FX) without manual factor selection.
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
why_all: High-dimensional MIDAS with regularization is well suited to nowcasting a quarterly ABNB KPI from many weekly/daily alt-data series (Trends, calendar pace, reviews index, FX) without manual factor selection.

name: midasr
what_it_holds: The original/reference R MIDAS package (documented in a Journal of Statistical Software article): midas_r (NLS estimation), midas_nlpr, midas_sp (semi-parametric), midas_qr (quantile MIDAS), robust SE and forecast utilities. Includes a /data folder with bundled example mixed-frequency datasets. 522 commits.
why_useful: Most mature, citable MIDAS implementation (basis for many derivative packages found this pass); quantile-MIDAS (midas_qr) is a route to nowcasting a distribution/range for ABNB nights or ADR rather than a point estimate.
